cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded card with Indian Oil offering fuel surcharge waivers, accelerated rewards on fuel purchases, and additional benefits on groceries and utility bill payments.

benefitRows.name: Amazon
benefitRows.howToAvail: You will receive the voucher within 60 days of your card activation(first transaction) via sms on registered mobile number.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
